SoM marker v4 — proposal vs current renders

Current renders (v3) draw an opaque ring on the exact point being judged; the Set-of-Mark paper (arXiv 2310.11441) has no such element. Its marks ARE the digits: white outlined text placed where the region's distance transform is maximal, i.e. as far from content boundaries as possible, with translucent overlays (alpha 0.1-0.5) and small regions handled by moving the mark off the region rather than shrinking it. v4 follows that: no ring, a 2-3px dot at the point, the digit as the mark with a white outline, a leader line that stops short of the point, and placement chosen by local edge density over 16 angles x 3 radii (our stand-in for the distance transform, since answers are points and carry no region).

Left = v3 (current, ring + filled badge)  |  Right = v4 (proposed).
